description: This file defines the LoginActivity class for an Android TV application. It implements a login screen with D-pad focus handling, input validation, and navigation to the main activity upon successful login.

classes.name: LoginActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that provides a login UI optimized for TV, with focus management and validation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the UI components, sets focusability, and attaches event handlers.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs basic validation of the username and password inputs.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles the login attempt, validation, and navigation to MainActivity.

methods.name: createIntent
methods.description: Static method to create an intent to start LoginActivity.
